awk01.title: Rating gym habits
awk01.script:
Hook
- "Rating gym habits I see every day in Madinah."

Body
- A quick score out of 10 for each one: skipping the warm-up (2), scrolling your phone for 5 minutes between sets (3), doing the same workout for two years (1), writing down your weights (10).

Payoff
- "If you track your lifts, you're ahead of most of the gym."

CTA
- "I'm Khalid from IFA. Follow for more."

awk02.title: "What's your biggest gym mistake?"
awk02.script:
Hook
- Khalid with a mic: "What's the biggest mistake you made in the gym?"

Body
- 3–4 quick answers from members who agreed to be filmed.

Payoff
- Khalid gives a one-line fix for the best answer.

CTA
- "Want me to fix yours? Comment below. Khalid, IFA."

Notes
- Only film people with their permission.

awk03.title: POV: a year in and no change
awk03.script:
Hook
- "POV: you've trained for a year and you look exactly the same."

Body
- "You're lifting the same weight for the same reps every week. Your body has no reason to change. Add one rep or a little weight each week, and write it down."

Payoff
- "Small jumps, every week. That's the whole secret."

CTA
- "Follow IFA for more."

awk04.title: Things I'd tell my younger self
awk04.script:
Hook
- "Three things I wish someone told me when I started training."

Body
- [Khalid's 3 real lessons, one line each]

Payoff
- The lesson that matters most: [his pick].

CTA
- "I'm Khalid from IFA. Which one hit you?"

awk05.title: Training in the Madinah heat
awk05.script:
Hook
- "Training in Madinah in this heat? Do this."

Body
- Train early morning or after Isha, drink water through the day not just at the gym, and cut the intensity on the hottest days instead of skipping.

Payoff
- "Consistency beats one perfect session."

CTA
- "Khalid, IFA. Follow for more."

awk06.title: Myth or fact (quick-fire)
awk06.script:
Hook
- "Gym myths. Myth or fact? Go."

Body
- "You need to train two hours a day: myth. You can burn belly fat with crunches: myth. Sleep affects your results: fact."

Payoff
- "Which one did you believe?"

CTA
- "I'm Khalid from IFA. Part 2 coming."

awk07.title: Fix your squat in 15 seconds
awk07.script:
Hook
- "If your squat looks like this, watch this." (Show a common mistake, with a willing member or Khalid acting it out.)

Body
- One cue only, e.g. "Spread the floor with your feet and keep your chest proud."

Payoff
- Before and after, side by side.

CTA
- "Save this for leg day. Khalid, IFA."

awk08.title: Day in the life of a personal trainer in Madinah
awk08.script:
Hook
- "What a personal trainer's day actually looks like in Madinah."

Body
- Quick clips: Fajr, first client, his own training, prayer breaks, evening clients, [the real parts of his day].

Payoff
- "It's not just training people. It's a business."

CTA
- "Want to do this as a job? That's what I teach at IFA."

Notes
- This one fits IFA best. Film across a full day.

awk09.title: What personal trainers won't tell you
awk09.script:
Hook
- "Things your personal trainer won't tell you."

Body
- "You don't need us forever. A good trainer teaches you to train yourself. And the best ones keep learning too."

Payoff
- "If your trainer isn't teaching you, ask why."

CTA
- "I'm Khalid. I train trainers at IFA."

awk10.title: How much do personal trainers really earn?
awk10.script:
Hook
- "How much does a personal trainer in Saudi actually make?"

Body
- [Khalid's honest range, or what he made in year 1 vs now, only if he is comfortable sharing]. "Most new trainers earn less than they should because nobody teaches them the business side."

Payoff
- "Same skills, very different income."

CTA
- "Follow IFA. I'll show you how."

awk11.title: Gym etiquette
awk11.script:
Hook
- "Gym rules nobody tells you."

Body
- Re-rack your weights, wipe the bench, don't hog three machines, and never film people without asking.

Payoff
- "Be the person everyone's happy to see at the gym."

CTA
- "Khalid, IFA. Tag someone who needs this."

awk12.title: Do this, not that
awk12.script:
Hook
- "Stop doing this in the gym. Do this instead."

Body
- Three quick swaps, e.g. ego lifting → controlled reps; random workouts → a simple plan; no rest days → planned rest.

Payoff
- "Better results, fewer injuries."

CTA
- "I'm Khalid from IFA. Follow for more."
